title: A Continuous-Time Generalization of the LPV Fundamental Lemma
summary: Controller design for physical systems directly from data is of tremendous interest in both the industry and academia. However, the research on direct data-driven control has thus far mainly focused on discrete-time linear time-invariant systems. To make the highly non-trivial step to continuous-time nonlinear systems, this paper explores an intermediate route through the framework of linear parameter-varying (LPV) systems.
